innovation_summary: Deterministic local GPU-health scoring now composes into a multi-GPU integrity quorum over caller-supplied thermal/power/ECC and numerical-integrity signals. The new quorum produces NOMINAL/WARNING/CRITICAL state, identifies review candidates, fails closed on a caller-supplied non-finite numerical-integrity signal, and emits a deterministic SHA-256 receipt while explicitly retaining operational_authority=false and hardware_action=false. Native unittest and public-truth surfaces were extended to cover the mechanism.
